note: Both sets read values off the stacked thickness plots, but Set A binds most numbers to plausible layer/location pairs (e.g., total ~25 mm at the TE of the 25% span section, ~5 mm total at the pressure side of the 100% span section, ~10 mm foam at 77% span), while Set B repeatedly reports whole-stack or leading-edge heights as individual layer thicknesses (e.g., CarbonUD 85-90 mm at suction/pressure side or LE, foam 50 mm at 25% span, total 80 mm at the pressure side of the 44% span section). Set B also invents or misreads values such as 0 mm foam at 100% span and CarbonUD 4 mm at 100% span where the plot shows little or no such layer. Set A's weaknesses are a handful of mislocated totals (50/80/88 mm assigned to pressure/suction side rather than the LE peak), over-thick glass_triax (11 mm), and a wrong 'dominant layer at LE = glass_uni' claim, plus many trivial legend-only material claims. Overall Set A is the more faithful extraction.
